chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Hammad ibn 'Uthman from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'Pray the two rak'ahs of Fajr before Fajr, and after it, and at it.'

key_terms.رَكْعَتَا اَلْفَجْرِ: The two voluntary rak'ahs of the Fajr prayer
key_terms.قَبْلَ اَلْفَجْرِ: Before the sunrise (time of Fajr prayer)

ai.seo_question: When should the two voluntary rak'ahs of Fajr be prayed according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the flexibility of the two sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr, permitting them before, at, or after the emergence of true dawn (subh al-sadiq). This narration highlights the scholarly distinction between the start of the prayer time and the moment of sunrise, emphasizing the Prophet's tradition of maintaining this voluntary prayer as a spiritual preparation for the obligatory duty.
